## Summary

Describe the learner-facing or developer-facing change.

## Pedagogical Intent

Explain what the change is intended to help a learner notice, compare, or do.
Use `Not applicable` for maintenance-only changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate:vr`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Complete browser flow tested
- [ ] Narrow mobile layout tested
- [ ] Keyboard interaction checked
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes

## WebXR Validation

- [ ] No WebXR behavior changed
- [ ] Meta Quest test completed using the deployed HTTPS build
- [ ] Headset validation is still needed and is identified below

Headset model, seated/standing setup, and controls tested:

## Data And Privacy

- [ ] No student-identifiable data collection or analytics were added
- [ ] New or changed data/visualization sources are documented
- [ ] Generated figure assets and cached source-data diffs were reviewed

## Review Notes

Call out URL parameters, module phases, examples, known limitations, or follow-up
work that will help the reviewer reproduce the change.
